_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in. config.json is gitignored - never commit the token.
_note_site_base_url: Baked into the approved template - get the domain live BEFORE creating the template, or you'll need a new template to change it. Use the canonical host (www), not the redirecting apex.
_note_image_base_url: Where the card images are publicly served from. Must be reachable by Meta.
